independentCache.scope: Independent read-only VM request/response admission and source comparison; no real browser, storage or network claim.

biologicalSuccessionRepair.guardPolicy: Exact predecessor, distinct successor and current-file SHA comparisons preserved; mutations and forged endpoints remain rejected. Added-source digest is literal.
biologicalSuccessionRepair.additionalCorrection: The V158 test now explicitly asserts the immutable historical procedural source and the reviewed new raster-support descriptor, then compares every other metadata field strictly. No historical JSON/XLSX or runtime was changed.
biologicalSuccessionRepair.publicationState: No commit, push or remote/local ref mutation by this agent; awaiting authorized parent commit, API object preparation, parent exact-API-commit build, and explicit final ref signal.

nativeMissionObservation.scope: Production GameEngine.start/update/drawActor lifecycle for the real special-black-cocoon mission; a Node host observation, not a browser journey or a complete mission playthrough.
nativeMissionObservation.repositoryState: Uncommitted biological integration at the frozen runtime hashes listed below; other agents own concurrent release files. This receipt does not claim a clean working tree.

declaredSubstitutions.browser: Node EventTarget window/document facade, focused canvas facade, no real browser.
declaredSubstitutions.requestAnimationFrame: Stub returning 1; no autonomous animation callback. cancelAnimationFrame is a no-op.
declaredSubstitutions.time: Production engine.update(dt), stepped by the existing tick helper at 60 Hz, with a final fractional step.
declaredSubstitutions.images: Initial Image facade reads shipped raster dimensions and dispatches load/error microtasks. Native player body/modular/transit/colonial images are then replaced in the engine image Map by real PNG/WebP decodes from @napi-rs/canvas; human-resin-support is also a real PNG decode. Other images remain host facades.
declaredSubstitutions.canvas: The host constructor canvas uses a tracing context. The three observed drawActor calls use a separate native 640x360 Canvas context.
declaredSubstitutions.encounters: The existing engine-host fixture retains spawnedEnemiesV188, then clears enemies, squadActors and hazards and sets coopEnabled=false. This observation therefore does not exercise combat, companions, hazards or co-op.
declaredSubstitutions.input: KeyE and KeyD are added to and removed from the actual engine.keys Set. This exercises native update/action processing but does not test DOM keyboard event dispatch.
declaredSubstitutions.save: The actual engine.captureResumeState method was called; no external persistence or save-file write occurred.

captureResumeStateComparison.method: At each observation, JSON.stringify(engine.captureResumeState()) is captured before drawActor and compared for exact string equality against a new capture immediately after drawActor. The executed script throws on any difference.
captureResumeStateComparison.limitation: Only the equality result was retained in the tool output; this receipt does not invent missing snapshot payloads or their hashes.

limits: No browser journey, complete mission traversal, external save reload, combat or performance claim.
QZ17 route/start composition was reviewed separately in source and covered by the integration and independent lifecycle tests; it was not executed by this particular script.
This receipt records observations already returned successfully by the tool; no tests were rerun to materialize it.
No repository source or asset was modified by this observation or receipt creation.

gameplay.hashRepairCoverage: This reward mismatch is not resolved by the integrity/succession repair. That repair covers the separately observed31Full-release failures and Excel succession failures.

boardingRewardCorrection.scope: Refresh the existing APC convoy canonical reward after its defended boarding, before either completion callback; reject stopped, invalidated or superseded boarding sequences. Three repository files only.
boardingRewardCorrection.sourceEdits: The native reward calculation is extracted into apcConvoyRewardsV121 and reused by initial completion and the deferred finalizer. The finalizer synchronizes apcConvoyV121.rewards, mission.rewards, event.rewards and event.kills. It runs before the presentation callback, which can pause the engine. completeMission is never replayed.

declaredFixture.kind: Controlled nonterminal state derived from the real CI convoy checkpoint; not an unmodified full browser replay.
declaredFixture.actualActions: Native E extraction, native simulation and real covering-fire damage produce the death and terminal result. Resume uses the Save-sanitized pending checkpoint. Skip is exercised before and after the kill; actual retreat resolution precedes stop and a replacement mission.
declaredFixture.substitutions: Existing Node engine host supplies DOM/EventTarget, Image dimension/load facades, RAF stubs and tracing Canvas. Inputs are engine key states. No engine gameplay method is replaced; no terminal reward, death or successful outcome is fabricated.

observedRegression.withoutExtraKill: The full canonical reward object remains unchanged; 20 kills and hull340 still give1300 credits.

nodeEvidence.note: Five added regression scenarios against the original runtime, before the patch.
The same five scenarios after the runtime correction.
Complete handover suite; includes the five regressions and the final persistence/retreat fixture refinements.
Handover plus convoy story V161 and history V162 on the final repository files.

boardingRewardCorrection.counting: The five regressions are included in43 handover cases, and those43 are included in the final55-case group. Counts are not additive.

browserEvidence.distinction: The previous CI Chromium journey revealed the mismatch. The correction is verified here by Node production-engine tests; their success does not claim a corrected Chromium journey.

boardingRewardCorrection.limitations: The patch changes APC deferred accounting and handover delivery guards, not other mission formulas, extraction combat rules, enemy deaths or vehicle destruction validation. No new test run was performed to create this receipt.

finalRewardSuccession.scope: Exact integrity receipts for the independently reviewed deferred convoy reward correction; no runtime edits by this agent.
